evidence: TurretTemplate parser reads laserDefenceEnergyUse; when present it sets metadata l.bE true and installs TurretProjectileBehavior laser-defence logic.

TurretTemplate parser reads interceptProjectiles_withTags; when present it sets metadata l.bF true and installs projectile-interceptor behavior. CustomUnit runtime checks l.bF before drawing/interpreting interceptor range state.
TurretTemplate parser reads limitingAngle; any non-negative limitingAngle sets metadata l.bG true for runtime turret-angle limit handling.

CustomUnitLoader finalization scans armed turret templates and sets l.ex true when targeting cannot be decided by unit-level tags alone; CustomUnit targetability code then scans turret tag filters before accepting a target.
notes: Derived flag, not a direct INI boolean.

evidence: CustomUnitLoader finalization chooses the non-linked attack turret with delay above the UI threshold and stores its index in l.em; CustomUnit.bW uses cL[em].reloadTimer / delay for reload progress display.
notes: Derived from TurretTemplate delay and link state.

evidence: CustomUnitLoader finalization chooses the turret with warmup above the UI threshold and stores its index in l.en; CustomUnit.bW uses cL[en].warmupTimer / warmup for warmup progress display.
TurretTemplate parser resolves attachedTo links and sets l.fU true; CustomUnit turret update code checks fU to propagate angle/timer updates to attached child turrets.
TurretTemplate parser reads isMainNanoTurret and stores the current TurretTemplate in l.fV; CustomUnit nano-turret helpers read fV.e for the main nano turret index.

TurretTemplate parser reads chargeEffectImage into turret charge-effect image field and sets l.fP true; CustomUnit rendering checks l.fP before drawing per-turret charge effect images by warmup ratio.

OrderableUnit.a(int,float) increments cL[turretIndex].aimAngle by deltaAngle. CustomUnit overrides this to propagate the same delta to attached turret links when metadata.hasAttachedTurretLinks is true.
notes: Base implementation for turret aim-angle adjustment.

evidence: CustomUnit.a(int,float) increments the selected turret aim angle and, when metadata.hasAttachedTurretLinks is true, applies the same delta to attached child turrets whose attachedToIndex matches the changed turret.
notes: Override of OrderableUnit.addTurretAimAngle with attached-turret propagation.

evidence: OrderableUnit.aT() returns -1 by default; call sites use it to select a preferred nano/repair turret index and fall back when -1.
notes: Base default for units without a main nano turret.

evidence: CustomUnit.aT() returns metadata.mainNanoTurret.e or -1; metadata.mainNanoTurret is set only by [turret_*]isMainNanoTurret.

parseFromConfig stores its leg-vs-arm boolean parameter into LegOrArmTemplate.c after arm sections force lockMovement=true and explodeOnDeath=false.
hidden LogicBoolean is parsed into q; LegOrArmTemplate.p is set only when q == LogicBoolean.trueBoolean and runtime skips the leg/arm before dynamic hidden checks.
image_leg and image_middle parser keys both write LegOrArmTemplate.x; runtime draw path reads it for the middle/leg segment.

image_foot and image_end parser keys both write LegOrArmTemplate.B; runtime draw path reads it for the foot/end segment.

image_foot_shadow and image_end_shadow parser keys both write LegOrArmTemplate.D; draw path checks it for shadow/end rendering.
drawLegWhenZoomedOut and drawFootWhenZoomedOut explicit config values set LegOrArmTemplate.E=true; legacy fallback only runs when this flag is false.
